compute_velocity_throw: compute the throw velocity vector and trajectory path points given a start point, end point, and gravity value
viz_and_get_humanoid_throw: visualize the humanoid throw trajectory and return the velocity vector based on the current mouse ray cast
get_sim: get the simulation object from the app service for the current agent
init_gui_throw_helper: initialize a GuiThrowHelper instance with an app service and agent index for GUI-based object throwing
draw_throw_path: draw the throw trajectory path with endpoint circles on the GUI using the gui drawer service
